decisions.reason: The premium raisin Christmas stollen is still marketed in 2024 and its repeated gold-medal recognition suggests strong seasonal demand and brand value, so management would likely retain it.

The dark barley malt rye bread remained on its own product page through 2024 while several other 2023 breads disappeared, indicating it likely earned a stable place in the assortment despite some normal portfolio-pruning risk.
The marzipan Christmas stollen kept its own page in 2023 and 2024, which points to continued relevance as a specialty seasonal product that fits a German bakery's established festive range.
